import asyncio
import os
from liter_llm import create_client
from liter_llm._internal_bindings import SearchRequest

async def main() -> None:
    client = create_client(api_key=os.environ["API_KEY"])
    request = SearchRequest.from_json("{\"model\":\"brave/web-search\",\"query\":\"contract test query\"}")
    result = await client.search(request)
